fields.Name: T267 - Knowledge Configuration Search Scopes Manager
fields.Description: Exercises the search-scope master/detail manager (SelectScope/CreateNewScope, SelectScopeTab with child grids) — a distinct multi-tab CRUD manager separate from the other config sections.

InputDefinition.goal: In the Knowledge Hub 'Configuration' screen (via application switcher then Configuration), open the 'Search Scopes' section. It shows a scope list on the left with a '+ New' button and a detail area on the right. Click an existing scope (or click '+ New' to create a draft), and confirm the detail area shows a tab strip (Definition / Providers / External Indexes / Entities / Storage / Permissions) with the Definition form (Name, Icon, Description, Status). Click across a couple of tabs and confirm the detail content changes. You do NOT need to save. If no scopes exist, seeing the empty-state plus the New control is success. Pages can take 10-30s to load in this resource-constrained environment — wait, don't navigate away.

judgeValidationCriteria: The Search Scopes section shows a scope list with a New control and a detail area
Selecting (or creating) a scope reveals the Definition form plus a tab strip, and switching tabs changes the detail content
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages (a valid no-scopes empty state is acceptable)
